claim.why_it_matters: Heading at the wrong level: 6.3 is a subsection of clause 6 (##) and a sibling of '### 6.1', but is rendered at ##, the same level as its parent.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page (II-22) shows '6.3 PROGRAM CLASSES' as a plain unstyled heading line, and the markdown carries the identical text '## 6.3 PROGRAM CLASSES'. No heading is missing and nothing is misquoted. The PDF has no heading levels at all; the hierarchy is carried by the clause number 6.3, which the markdown keeps verbatim. The markdown's heading depth is a formatting artifact and is inconsistent across the whole region (clause 6 '##', 6.1 '###', 6.2 '##', 6.3 '##'; likewise 4.1 '###' vs 4.2 '##'), so this is markdown furniture, not a content discrepancy with the PDF. The text, numbering and meaning are unchanged.
